title: Number of Subarrays With GCD Equal to K
goal: Count subarrays whose greatest common divisor is exactly k.
strategy: Extend each start while updating its rolling GCD. GCD can only lose factors; if the current GCD is not divisible by k, no further extension can recover the target.
